an5.218:1.1: CCXVIII. Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā apāsādike. Katame pañca? Appasannā na ppasīdanti, pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti, Satthu sāsanaṃ akataṃ hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittam assa na ppasīdati. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā apāsādike.
an5.218:2.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā pāsādike. Katame pañca? Appasannā pasīdanti, pasannānañ ca bhīyobhāvo hoti, Satthu sāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittam assa pasīdati. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā pāsādike ti.
